title: NERO prospective shadow warning protocol

may_do: Generate private review candidates from predeclared rules
Rehearse evidence review and bounded support planning
Publish methods and aggregate feasibility findings after review
must_not_do: Describe a signal as an AI, job-loss or crisis warning
Withdraw benefits, employment, services or support
Trigger public action from NERO alone
Replace or mutate a prior vintage

target_tiers.name: data_quality_event
target_tiers.definition: A schema, coverage, model-version, release-timing or revision event that may invalidate a signal.

target_tiers.name: employment_trend_review_candidate
target_tiers.definition: One separate occupation-SA4 modelled series satisfies a fixed descriptive rule.
target_tiers.interpretation_limit: A reason to review evidence, not an adverse event or causal claim.

target_tiers.name: independent_worker_flow_event
target_tiers.definition: A predeclared worker-flow outcome is observed in an independent or explicitly partially dependent comparator at matching resolution.

target_tiers.name: continuity_or_agency_event
target_tiers.definition: A direct household continuity-floor or agency outcome is observed for the cohort and period.

target_tiers.name: ai_attributable_event
target_tiers.definition: Observed AI adoption and work redesign have a credible counterfactual causal link to a worker or household outcome.

source_schedule.rule: Check the official page on the expected date. Record actual release and retrieval times. A delay is data, not permission to reuse the prior status as current.

scope.aggregation_rule: Never sum or combine NERO occupations or regions. Evaluate every occupation-SA4 series separately.
scope.classification_break_rule: A new occupation or geography version creates a new series family. Do not splice without a reviewed, versioned concordance and break flag.

vintage.immutability_rule: Write a new release-period and retrieval-version record. Never overwrite, repair in place or silently deduplicate.

as_of_rule.selection: For a decision at release r, use only source vintages with publisher release timestamp at or before r and the first published NERO estimate then available.
as_of_rule.baseline_window: Every rolling feature must end before or at the current reference period and must come from the same as-of release.
as_of_rule.publication_time: Measure lead time from publisher release timestamp, never from the middle of the reference month.
as_of_rule.late_or_corrected_source: Add as new information at its actual availability time. Do not rewrite the earlier shadow decision.
as_of_rule.missing: Emit unavailable. Do not forward-fill an alert or green state.

candidate_families.risk: Common persistent trends create many repeated flags.

candidate_families.feature: Slope over a preregistered trailing window
candidate_families.risk: Strong smoothing can make a slow path appear precise and persistent.

candidate_families.feature: Change in trend relative to a trailing seasonal baseline
candidate_families.risk: Later revisions can move both the current and baseline values.

candidate_families.feature: A declared run length plus a minimum cumulative decline
candidate_families.risk: Direction alone has very high alert burden in the frozen history.

candidate_families.feature: NERO trend plus a preregistered non-NERO measure
candidate_families.risk: Comparator independence and resolution must be explicit.

detector_registration.selection_rule: Register all candidates and thresholds before the holdout. Do not report only the best-performing rule.
detector_registration.episode_rule: Consecutive flagged months for one series count as one episode until the preregistered reset condition is met.

revision_tests.formula: first vintage after which later revisions remain within the preregistered tolerance

smoothing_tests.method: Inject known one-month level breaks of several declared magnitudes into a copy of a series and measure detector delay.
smoothing_tests.claim_limit: Tests pipeline and detector mechanics, not NERO's response to a real shock because it bypasses the JSA model.

smoothing_tests.method: Inject gradual declines over declared windows and measure repeated-alert burden and episode handling.
smoothing_tests.claim_limit: Tests rules, not empirical predictive accuracy.

smoothing_tests.method: After a separately verified real event, compare first-published NERO path, later revisions and event onset.
smoothing_tests.claim_limit: Valid only after event definition and independence review.

comparator_registry.role: Broad occupation or state coherence and worker-transition triangulation
comparator_registry.reason: NERO uses and reconciles to LFS inputs.
comparator_registry.may_validate: Different transition constructs with explicit dependence caveat
comparator_registry.must_not_validate: Independent accuracy of NERO employment levels

comparator_registry.reason: JSA lists online vacancy information among NERO inputs.

comparator_registry.source: ABS 2026 Census of Population and Housing
comparator_registry.role: Prospective external point benchmark close to August 2026
comparator_registry.may_validate: Compatible occupation-geography level or rank estimates if the required cells are released
comparator_registry.must_not_validate: Warning lead time, AI attribution, household continuity or agency

comparator_registry.role: Annual separations, engagements, retrenchment and job-change context
comparator_registry.may_validate: Broad worker-flow direction where definitions and periods align
Predeclared local support-pressure outcome after policy and population controls

comparator_registry.source: Prospective governed employer-worker deployment, task and payroll panel
comparator_registry.role: Direct adoption, redesign and worker-flow outcome
comparator_registry.may_validate: Site and occupation outcomes with credible treatment and comparison design

evaluation.split: Contiguous time blocks by actual release vintage. Never random row splits.
evaluation.model_versions: Evaluate each NERO version separately and treat changes as breaks.
evaluation.base_rate: Report independent event episodes divided by eligible series-episodes. Do not use NERO decline frequency as event prevalence.
metrics: False-negative rate with clustered confidence interval
False-discovery rate with clustered confidence interval
Specificity and false-positive rate under a defensible non-event sample
Alert episodes per 100 eligible series per month
First-alert lead-time distribution from publication timestamp
Net decision value under preregistered error costs
evaluation.uncertainty: Use cluster-aware or block-resampling methods for serial and spatial dependence. Publish numerator, denominator and effective sample assumptions.
evaluation.look_ahead_test: Re-run every decision from the immutable as-of panel and fail if any feature or comparator was published later.
evaluation.multiple_testing: Report all preregistered detectors and control family selection. Do not search thresholds across the holdout and publish only the winner.

error_adjudication.true_positive: A new alert episode is followed by the preregistered independent event within horizon H.
error_adjudication.false_positive: A new alert episode is not followed by that event within H after outcome observation is complete.
error_adjudication.false_negative: A target event occurs without an alert in the preregistered warning window.
error_adjudication.true_negative: An eligible sampled non-alert period has no event, using a scheme that prevents abundant ordinary months from dominating accuracy.
rules: Adjudicate event definitions without seeing detector identity where judgement is required.
Do not relabel conflicted or missing outcomes as negatives.
Keep uncertain events separate and run sensitivity bounds.
Record concurrent shocks and alternative explanations.
Price the two error types for the bounded action before evaluation.

monthly_run.action: Retrieve and hash the original archive on actual release day.
Validate archive, schema, classifications, row coverage, dates and duplicate keys.
Freeze a vintage record before transformation.
Diff all overlapping observations and calculate revision diagnostics.
Run only the frozen detector version on the as-of panel.
Collapse persistent flags into episodes and enforce cooldown and reset.
Write an immutable private shadow decision with no external consequence.
Freeze same-day comparator vintages and independence classifications.
Complete human review and log time, disagreement, missing evidence and capacity.
Attach later outcomes without mutating the original signal or decision.

rehearsal_scenarios: Rapid employment break hidden by smoothing
Later revision reversing a review candidate
State-wide recession affecting all five cohorts
Local employer closure unrelated to AI
NERO decline with stable household continuity
Household continuity deterioration without NERO decline
Beneficial augmentation with better worker and service outcomes

review_milestones.permitted_result: First revision diff and schema comparison
Revision smoke test, operational rehearsal and alert-load report
First-release revision curves, annual alert stability and process reliability
review_milestones.prohibited_result: Causal AI warning unless all higher-tier evidence also exists

review_milestones.condition: ABS releases compatible 2026 Census employment data
review_milestones.permitted_result: External point-estimate and rank comparison for the frozen August 2026 NERO archive
review_milestones.prohibited_result: Lead-time, adoption, continuity or agency validation

review_milestones.condition: Effective independent event sample reaches preregistered precision
review_milestones.permitted_result: Out-of-time warning evaluation at the applicable target tier
review_milestones.prohibited_result: Extrapolation beyond validated population, geography, outcome and action

monthly_shadow: Protocol, detector, target and error costs frozen before next release
Immutable archive and decision records implemented
Schema and classification changes fail visibly
Expected alert burden is within named human review capacity
All outputs are private, non-causal and have no individual consequence
limited_public_review_signal: Independent target at compatible population, geography and time
Effective event sample meets preregistered confidence precision after dependence adjustment
Lower confidence bounds for sensitivity and precision beat named simple baselines and action requirements
Alert episode burden is within review capacity
Lower-tail lead time exceeds bounded-action mobilisation time
Revision alert-flip rate is within a preregistered action-cost tolerance
Performance remains acceptable for small series and every scoped occupation
Reasonable specifications and confounder checks do not reverse the conclusion
Independent statistical, worker and ethics review approves exact language

stop_conditions: A later archive is used to reconstruct an earlier information set
A NERO model input is labelled independent truth
Thresholds or outcomes are changed after holdout inspection
Overlapping alert months are counted as independent events
Reference date substitutes for publication date in lead time
Missing or suppressed data inherit an earlier status
Aggregate performance hides failure in small series or a scoped occupation
The signal is described as AI adoption, displacement, household crisis or causation
The proposed action can withdraw support or target a person or place
Observed warning lead time is shorter than action mobilisation time
public_label_if_eventually_authorised: This modelled employment series met a pre-registered review condition. It does not show why employment changed and is not evidence of AI adoption or household crisis.
